topic: Pure Fourier Series: Decoding the Language of Waves

sections.title: The Intuition: From Music to Math (1 minute)
lecture_lines: Complex signals are chords of simple sine waves.
Frequency and amplitude build every sound we hear.
Imagine an equalizer breaking down jagged waves.
animations: Draw a sine wave in #FF00FF (Label: 'Simple Tone').
Overlay a complex wave in #00FFFF (Label: 'Complex Signal').
Decompose the complex wave into its constituent sine waves.

sections.title: The Mathematical DNA: The Fourier Formula (1.5 minutes)
lecture_lines: The Fourier series models periodic functions as sums.
Coefficients act as volume knobs for frequencies.
Adding more sine waves refines the sharp edges.
Each term builds the target waveform piece-by-piece.
The sum creates complex, precise mathematical shapes.
animations: Display Euler's formula e^(iθ) = cos(θ) + i*sin(θ) in #FFFFFF.
Animate a point rotating around the complex unit circle.
Show the projection of the rotation onto the axes.
Explain the sum of sine waves visually using the formula.
Display the final integral equation in #00FF00.

sections.title: Calculating the Coefficients: The Inner Product (1.5 minutes)
lecture_lines: Orthogonality isolates specific wave components perfectly.
The integral acts as a mathematical sieve.
We extract unique frequencies from chaotic mixtures.
Each coefficient reveals a specific harmonic layer.
Inner products filter signals into pure components.
animations: Visualize two wave functions as vectors in space.
Show the dot product operation between the two vectors.
Calculate the area under the product of the waves.
Project one wave onto the other, highlighting the overlap.
Show the resulting coefficient as a scalar value.

sections.title: Real-World Application: The Sonic Bat (1 minute)
lecture_lines: Bats use sonar to map their environment.
The brain acts as a Fourier Analyzer.
Echoes unzip into frequency peaks identifying shapes.
animations: Show a bat emitting a sound pulse in #FF4500.
Visualize the echo returning with a phase shift.
Display the frequency spectrum of the processed echo.
